title: Polygon Angle Calculator
description: For a regular n-sided polygon get each interior angle, exterior angle and the interior sum.
howto: Enter the number of sides (3 or more).
Read the interior, exterior and total angles with the formulas.

faqs.a: Any n-gon splits into n−2 triangles from one vertex, and each triangle’s angles sum to 180°.
Yes — at each vertex they form a straight line, so they are supplementary.

faqs.q: Does this work for irregular polygons?
faqs.a: Only the sum formula (n−2)×180° holds for irregular ones; equal angles need a regular polygon.
